newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Nokia Q1 profit seen higher.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Nokia Q1 profit seen higher.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 1,260 million markka median forecast for telecommunications group Nokia Oy's first quarter 1997 profit before tax and minority interest.
Profit before tax, minority interest EPS
(Profit forecast by 19 analysts, EPS by 15 analysts).
Nokia's Q1 results are due on April 29.
In January-March 1996, Nokia had a 399 million markka profit before tax and minority interest.
In February, Nokia said it expected strong growth and profitability to continue in 1997.

All 19 analysts polled also gave forecasts for Nokia's full-year 1997 profit, with the median at 6,310 million markka (range 5,259-6,870 markka). The median of 17 full-year 1997 EPS forecasts was 15.74 markka (range 12.6-17.7 markka).

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, BZW Securities, Carnegie Securities, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Goldman Sachs, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merill Lynch, Morgan Stanley, Opstock, Postipankki, S-E Banken, Schroder Securities, Erik Selin and SBC Warburg.
